subject: Application: Civil Engineer, Land Infrastructure, Mackay, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Engineer, Land Infrastructure role with Aurecon in Mackay (SEEK 94845689 / Workday R32675).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work across Central Queensland, including Mackay. I do not yet have Australian land development consulting employment, so I would be joining for design, documentation and coordination support under mentoring.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

I saw your SEEK listing for Graduate Civil Engineer roles in Sydney (job 94951825) and am writing to you directly as the advert asks applicants to email kenneth@crau.com.au.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
